seam.rationale: Ordinary EndScene/Present/Clear code at proven DEVICE consumers is a legitimate post-init API boundary: a host-owned IDirect3DDevice9 published at 0x013C6510 is standard graphics-runtime state, not SecuROM callback reconstruction. However full frame/draw still depends on additional renderer object state (e.g. 0x017AA798) not reduced to the DEVICE global alone, and in-game publication remains externally blocked.
